name: 27512-decode-qwen3next80b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 on one a3 node (half the node).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, expert parallelism on across the same four ranks, one in-process vLLM engine. No router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: hybrid linear-attention sparse MoE decoder (Qwen3NextForCausalLM): 48 layers, three gated-delta-net layers per full-attention layer, every layer MoE with 512 routed experts and 10 active per token, ~79.5B total and ~3B active, bf16, ~159 GB of weights (~40 GB per GPU at TP=4).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, bounded at 512 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown, static seed 27512. streams and max_requests are one operating point and must move together.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 512 requests of 32 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 tokens out, min == max on both, `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant generating 1024-token responses from short prompts for 512 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
async-scheduling: true

# Load-bearing with the scenario's 512 streams: the engine's own default is 128, so without this
# the 512 concurrent requests are admitted 128 at a time and the declared operating point is not
# the one that runs.
max-num-seqs: 512

max-model-len: 2048
dtype: bfloat16

# Everything else stays at the engine's own default; the engine runs in-process, so no --host/--port.
